intro.zh: 1996 年，木柵線（今文湖線的一部分）通車，台北從此有了第一條捷運。三十年來，路網從一條高架線擴展到台北、新北與桃園三地：2017 年通車的機場捷運，把桃園國際機場接上台北的軌道路網；2020 年通車的環狀線，14 座車站全部位於新北，串起新店、中和、板橋與新莊，讓這些地方之間的往來不必再繞進台北市區。
intro.en: Taipei got its first metro line in 1996, when the Muzha Line (now part of the Wenhu Line) opened. In the thirty years since, the network has grown from a single elevated line into a system that reaches across Taipei, New Taipei, and Taoyuan. The Airport MRT, opened in 2017, connected Taoyuan International Airport to the city's rail network, and the Circular Line, opened in 2020, runs entirely through New Taipei. Its 14 stations link Xindian, Zhonghe, Banqiao, and Xinzhuang, so trips between them no longer have to detour through central Taipei.

intro.zh: 2021 年 4 月，台中捷運綠線正式通車，台中從此有了第一條捷運，也是台灣第五個捷運系統。綠線全線高架、無人駕駛，從北屯總站一路通往高鐵台中站，讓高鐵旅客多了一條直接進入市區的路線。在此之前，台中的軌道已經先有了大改變：2016 年台鐵台中站完成高架化，新站啟用，1917 年落成的紅磚舊站則被保留為國定古蹟；2025 年，從台中港通往市區的捷運藍線動工，預計約九年後完工。
intro.en: Taichung got its first metro line in April 2021, when the Taichung MRT Green Line opened, the fifth metro system in Taiwan. The fully elevated, driverless line runs from Beitun Main Station to Taichung HSR station, giving high-speed rail passengers another direct way into the city. Rail in the city had already changed before that. In 2016 the TRA's Taichung Station moved onto a new elevated line, and the red-brick station building from 1917 was preserved as a national historic site. In 2025 construction began on the Blue Line from the Port of Taichung into the city, with about nine years of work expected.

intro.zh: 2008 年，高雄捷運紅線在 3 月通車，橘線在同年 9 月接著通車，高雄從此有了第一條捷運。兩線交會的美麗島站，有一座由 4,500 片玻璃組成的「光之穹頂」，常被稱為世界最大的玻璃藝術作品。十多年來，路網從兩條十字交會的路線持續擴展：2015 年環狀輕軌開始營運，列車靠超級電容供電，沿線看不到架空電線，2024 年元旦環線正式閉合；同年 6 月，紅線延伸到岡山車站，與台鐵岡山站相連。
intro.en: Kaohsiung got its first metro line in 2008, when the Red Line opened in March, followed by the Orange Line that September. Where the two lines cross, Formosa Boulevard station holds the Dome of Light, made of 4,500 glass panels and often described as the largest glass artwork in the world. In the years since, the network has grown beyond those two crossing lines. The Circular Light Rail began service in 2015, its trams powered by supercapacitors with no overhead wires, and the loop was completed on New Year's Day 2024. That June the Red Line reached Gangshan station, connecting with the TRA station there.

intro.zh: 1872 年 10 月，新橋到橫濱的鐵路通車，這是日本第一條鐵路。之後東京的軌道由 JR、私鐵與地鐵一起構成：1925 年 11 月，山手線連成環狀，私鐵從新宿、澀谷、池袋等環線車站向郊外延伸；1927 年，銀座線通車，成為日本第一條地鐵。1960 年，都營淺草線與京成電鐵開始直通運轉，此後地鐵與私鐵、JR 的列車互相串連，乘客不必換車就能從郊外直達市中心；2023 年 3 月，相鐵與東急的直通線通車，橫濱西部也接上了這張網。
intro.en: Tokyo's rail history began in October 1872, when the line from Shimbashi to Yokohama opened as Japan's first railway. The city's network grew out of JR, private railways, and the subway together. In November 1925 the Yamanote Line became a full loop, with private railways reaching out to the suburbs from loop stations like Shinjuku, Shibuya, and Ikebukuro, and in 1927 the Ginza Line opened as Japan's first subway. In 1960 the Toei Asakusa Line began through service with Keisei, and since then subway, private, and JR trains have been linked so riders can go from the suburbs to the city center without changing trains. In March 2023 the Sotetsu and Tokyu link brought western Yokohama into the same web.

intro.zh: 1969 年，北京地鐵 1 號線完工，但要到 1981 年才正式對一般乘客開放，北京從此有了第一條地鐵。五十多年來，路網從一條東西向的線路擴展到超過 900 公里（2025 年底）：2008 年奧運前夕通車的首都機場線，讓旅客從首都機場搭軌道就能進城；2019 年通車的大興機場線全自動駕駛、最高時速 160 公里，把城南的大興國際機場也接上了路網。
intro.en: Beijing finished its first subway line, Line 1, in 1969, though the public could not ride it until 1981. In the decades since, the network has grown from a single east-west line into more than 900 km of track by the end of 2025. The Capital Airport Express, opened just before the 2008 Olympics, let travelers ride the train from Beijing Capital Airport into the city, and the Daxing Airport Express, opened in 2019, runs fully automated at up to 160 km/h, connecting the new Daxing International Airport south of the city to the network.

intro.zh: 2005 年，跨座式單軌的 2 號線通車，重慶從此有了第一條城市軌道，也是中國西部的第一條。二十年來，路網從一條穿過住宅大樓的單軌（李子壩站就蓋在一棟大樓的 6 到 8 樓）擴展到橫跨長江與嘉陵江兩岸：3 號線全長約 55 公里，是全世界最長的單軌路線；2022 年啟用的紅岩村站深達 116 公尺，從其中一個出入口搭手扶梯下到月台要將近 8 分鐘。
intro.en: Chongqing got its first urban rail line in 2005, when Line 2, a straddle-type monorail, opened as the first line of its kind in western China. In the twenty years since, the network has grown from a monorail that runs through an apartment building (Liziba station sits on the sixth to eighth floors) into a system spanning both banks of the Yangtze and Jialing rivers. Line 3, about 55 km long, holds the Guinness record as the longest monorail line in the world, and Hongyancun station, opened in 2022, lies 116 meters underground, and the escalator ride down from one of its entrances takes almost eight minutes.

intro.zh: 2016 年，2 號線通車，東莞從此有了第一條軌道交通。這條線從東莞火車站往南延伸到虎門火車站，而虎門站就在廣深港高鐵上，可以直接搭高鐵前往香港西九龍。將近十年後，路網才迎來第二條線：2025 年 11 月通車的 1 號線長約 57 公里、設計時速 120 公里，與周邊的穗莞深等城際鐵路銜接，讓東莞與廣州、深圳之間的往來更加方便。
intro.en: Dongguan got its first rail line in 2016, when Line 2 opened. It runs south from Dongguan railway station to Humen railway station, a stop on the Guangzhou-Shenzhen-Hong Kong high-speed line where travelers can board direct trains to Hong Kong West Kowloon. Nearly a decade passed before the network gained a second line. Line 1, opened in November 2025, is about 57 km long with a design speed of 120 km/h, and it connects with the region's intercity railways, making trips between Dongguan, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen much easier.

intro.zh: 1997 年，地鐵 1 號線從西朗到黃沙的首段通車，廣州從此有了第一條地鐵。將近三十年來，路網從這一小段擴展成世界上最長的地鐵系統之一：2010 年通車的廣佛線，是中國第一條跨越兩座城市的地鐵，讓廣州與佛山之間可以直接搭地鐵往來；2021 年通車的 18 號線最高時速 160 公里，大幅拉近了城市南邊的番禺、南沙與市中心的距離。
intro.en: Guangzhou got its first metro line in 1997, when the opening section of Line 1 began running between Xilang and Huangsha. In the nearly thirty years since, the network has grown from that short stretch into one of the longest metro systems in the world. The Guangfo Line, opened in 2010, was the first metro in China to cross between two cities, letting riders travel directly between Guangzhou and Foshan, and Line 18, opened in 2021, runs at up to 160 km/h, bringing Panyu and Nansha in the south much closer to the city center.

intro.zh: 2013 年，地鐵 1 號線通車，哈爾濱從此有了第一條地鐵。列車特別為這裡的冬天設計，一、二月的氣溫常在攝氏零下 30 度上下。十多年來，路網從一條連接哈爾濱東站與南站的路線擴展到三條線：2021 年通車的 2 號線從地底穿越松花江，過江只要三分多鐘，把松花江北岸接上了市中心；2024 年 11 月，3 號線環線閉合，成為中國第一條位於高緯度嚴寒地區的環狀地鐵。
intro.en: Harbin got its first metro line in 2013, when Line 1 opened. Its trains were built for local winters, when January and February temperatures hover around minus 30°C. In the years since, the network has grown from a single line between Harbin East and Harbin South stations into three lines. Line 2, opened in 2021, tunnels under the Songhua River in just over three minutes, connecting the north bank to the city center, and in November 2024 Line 3 closed its loop, becoming China's first loop metro line in a high-latitude, severe-cold region.

intro.zh: 1979 年，地鐵第一段從石硤尾到觀塘通車，香港從此有了第一條地鐵；在此之前，九廣鐵路早在 1910 年就已經開通。四十多年來，路網從九龍的一小段擴展到港島、新界與大嶼山：1998 年隨新機場啟用的機場快綫，讓旅客從市區直達赤鱲角；2022 年東鐵綫過海延伸到金鐘，成為第四條穿越維多利亞港的鐵路，新界東北的乘客從此不必轉車就能抵達港島。
intro.en: Hong Kong got its first metro line in 1979, when the opening MTR section ran from Shek Kip Mei to Kwun Tong, though the Kowloon-Canton Railway had already been running since 1910. In the four decades since, the network has grown from a short stretch in Kowloon to reach Hong Kong Island, the New Territories, and Lantau. The Airport Express, opened with the new airport in 1998, runs from the city straight to Chek Lap Kok, and in 2022 the East Rail Line crossed the harbor to Admiralty, becoming the fourth rail crossing of Victoria Harbour and giving riders from the northeastern New Territories a direct trip to Hong Kong Island.

intro.en: Macau got its first railway of any kind in 2019, when the Light Rapid Transit's Taipa Line opened. Its trains run without drivers, and at first they served only Taipa and Cotai. Since then the network has gradually reached further. In December 2023 the line crossed the water on the lower deck of the Sai Van Bridge to Barra station on the Macau Peninsula, near A-Ma Temple, and the Hengqin Line, opened in 2024, reaches the Hengqin border crossing about two minutes from Lotus station, giving travelers another way into Hengqin.

An air raid in 1945 badly damaged the line, but the Taniyama Line was running again just 12 days later, and the Kyushu Shinkansen reached Kagoshima-Chuo in 2004, with through trains from Hakata after the full line opened in 2011.

intro.en: Nagano got its own local railway in 1926, when the first section of the Nagano Electric Railway opened, reaching Nagano Station two years later. The atomic bombing on August 9, 1945 stopped every line, destroying 16 cars and killing 120 employees, and in September 2022 the Nishi-Kyushu Shinkansen opened, cutting the trip from Hakata to Nagasaki from about two hours to about 90 minutes.

intro.en: Nagoya joined the rail network in May 1886, when Nagoya Station opened on a line that later became part of the Tokaido Main Line. The city's first subway line, today's Higashiyama Line, opened in 1957. In October 2004 the Meijo Line was completed as a loop and the Aonami Line began carrying passengers the same day, and in 2005 Linimo opened for the Aichi Expo as Japan's first commercial HSST maglev line.

intro.en: Naha got its first postwar railway in 2003, when the Okinawa Urban Monorail, known as Yui Rail, opened. intro.en: Niigata joined the rail network in 1904, when Niigata Station opened. The Joetsu Shinkansen opened in 1982, and the fastest trains now reach Tokyo in about 90 minutes. From 2018 Niigata Station was raised onto a viaduct in stages, letting riders change across the same platform between the Shinkansen and the Inaho limited express, and the work was finished in 2022.

intro.en: Okayama got its first urban rail line in 1912, when the Okayama Electric Tramway began running. At about 4.7 km with 16 stops, it is often called the smallest tram system in Japan. Over the century since, the city has become the rail hub between western Honshu and Shikoku. The Sanyo Shinkansen reached Okayama in 1972, and the city stayed the line's western terminus until the extension to Hakata in 1975. In 1988 the Great Seto Bridge opened, and the Marine Liner rapid service now reaches Takamatsu on Shikoku in about 55 minutes.

intro.zh: 1885 年，阪堺鐵道的難波到大和川段通車，這段路線至今仍是南海本線的一部分，也是日本現存最古老的私鐵路線。之後大阪的軌道由 JR、私鐵與地鐵共同構成：阪急、阪神、京阪、近鐵與南海從梅田、難波等站往京都、神戶、奈良與和歌山延伸；1933 年，御堂筋線通車，成為日本第一條公營地鐵；1964 年，大阪環狀線開始環狀運轉。2023 年 3 月，JR 大阪站的地下月台啟用；2025 年 1 月，Osaka Metro 中央線延伸到夢洲，迎接大阪世界博覽會。
intro.en: Osaka's rail history began in 1885, when the Hankai Railway opened between Namba and Yamatogawa. That stretch is still part of the Nankai Main Line and is the oldest private railway line in Japan still in operation. The city's network grew out of JR, private railways, and the subway together, with Hankyu, Hanshin, Keihan, Kintetsu, and Nankai reaching out from Umeda and Namba toward Kyoto, Kobe, Nara, and Wakayama. The Midosuji Line opened in 1933 as Japan's first publicly run subway, and the Osaka Loop Line began running as a full loop in 1964. In March 2023 new underground platforms opened at JR Osaka Station, and in January 2025 the Osaka Metro Chuo Line reached Yumeshima for Expo 2025.

intro.zh: 1880 年 11 月，幌內鐵道從小樽的手宮通到札幌，這是北海道第一條鐵路。如今札幌的軌道由 JR 北海道、市營地下鐵與路面電車構成：1971 年 12 月，南北線趕在隔年冬季奧運之前通車，札幌的三條地鐵線全都採用膠輪，行駛起來格外安靜；1992 年 7 月，新千歲機場站啟用，快速「Airport」從此由札幌站直達機場。2015 年 12 月，路面電車在薄野與西四丁目之間補上缺口，連成環狀；北海道新幹線延伸到札幌，則預計要到 2030 年代後期。
intro.en: Sapporo got Hokkaido's first railway in November 1880, when the Horonai Railway opened from Temiya in Otaru to Sapporo. Today the city's rail system is made up of JR Hokkaido, the city subway, and the streetcar. The Namboku Line opened in December 1971, just before the 1972 Winter Olympics, and all three subway lines run on rubber tires, which makes them unusually quiet. In July 1992 New Chitose Airport Station opened, and the Rapid Airport train began running directly from Sapporo Station to the airport. In December 2015 the streetcar closed the gap between Susukino and Nishi 4 chome to form a loop, while the Hokkaido Shinkansen extension to Sapporo is now expected in the late 2030s.

The 2011 Tohoku earthquake damaged the subway and halted service, but the full line was running again by April 29, little more than a month later. In the decades since, the network has grown step by step. The JR Sendai Airport Line, opened in 2007, gave Sendai Airport its first rail link, and in December 2015 the Tozai Line opened, crossing the Namboku Line at Sendai Station and giving the subway its cross shape.

The AREX airport railroad opened in 2007 between Incheon and Gimpo airports and reached Seoul Station in 2010, giving travelers a direct ride from the city center to Incheon, and in 2024 the GTX-A express began service, sharply cutting commute times between Seoul and Gyeonggi Province.

At the end of 2016 the Donghae Line began frequent commuter service, making trips toward Haeundae and Gijang much easier.

intro.en: Daegu got its first subway line in 1997, when Line 1 opened between Jincheon and Jungangno. In February 2003 an arson attack on a train at Jungangno station killed 192 people, and afterward Daegu's subway cars were refitted with flame-retardant interiors. In the nearly thirty years since its opening, the network has grown to three lines. Line 2 opened in 2005, crossing the city from east to west, and Line 3, opened in 2015, is Korea's first straddle-type monorail, fully elevated so riders can watch the city pass below.

In December 2020 the U5 was joined to the formerly isolated U55, so riders can now travel from Honow in the east all the way to Berlin Hauptbahnhof.

intro.en: Moscow got its first metro line in May 1935, when the first route opened from Sokolniki, splitting into two branches at Okhotny Ryad. The Moscow Central Circle opened in 2016 on an old railway ring, with fares integrated with the metro and free transfers, and in 2023 the Big Circle Line was completed, forming a second metro ring around the outer city.

intro.en: Vancouver got its driverless rail system in January 1986, when the SkyTrain Expo Line opened ahead of Expo 86 that year. SkyTrain now has 54 stations and about 50 miles of track.

intro.en: Mexico City got its first metro line in September 1969, when Line 1 opened between Zaragoza and Insurgentes. In the fifty-plus years since, the network has kept expanding. Line A, opened in 1991, was the first to reach into the State of Mexico, and Line 12, opened in 2012, ran from Mixcoac to Tlahuac in the south as the longest line of its time.

intro.en: Albuquerque got its modern rail line in July 2006, when the New Mexico Rail Runner Express began commuter service from Bernalillo to downtown Albuquerque. In 1994 the line was extended to Lambert International Airport, in 2003 it reached Scott Air Force Base on the Illinois side, and in 2006 a new branch opened southwest to Shrewsbury. An extension to MidAmerica Airport has been built and is now in testing.

intro.en: Takamatsu got its first electric railway in 1911, when a predecessor of today's Kotoden opened a line between Imabashi and Shido. Kotoden went bankrupt in 2001 but was rebuilt and still runs today.

intro.zh: 1875 年 7 月，鐵路經由新建的 Albert Bridge通到布里斯本，接上十年前從 Ipswich 出發的昆士蘭第一條鐵路。之後市郊鐵路逐步擴展到整個昆士蘭東南部：1979 年 11 月，第一段電氣化路線通車；2001 年 5 月，Airtrain 機場線通車，從市中心搭火車就能直達布里斯本機場。正在興建的 Cross River Rail預計 2029 年通車，將在市中心新增 4 座地下車站。
intro.en: Brisbane was connected to the railway in July 1875, when the new Albert Bridge linked the city to Queensland's first line, which had opened from Ipswich ten years earlier. Suburban rail then spread across South East Queensland. The first electric line opened in November 1979, and in May 2001 Airtrain began running trains from the city center straight to Brisbane Airport. Cross River Rail, now under construction, is expected to open in 2029 with 4 new underground stations in and around the city center.

intro.zh: 1856 年，阿得雷德到 Port Adelaide 的鐵路通車，阿得雷德從此有了鐵路。1958 年，市區路面電車全數停駛，只留下 1929 年通車、通往海邊 Glenelg的一條電車線，這條線後來成了路網擴張的起點：2007 年起，電車陸續延伸進市中心，2018 年再開通往植物園方向的支線。鐵路方面，2014 年 2 月 Seaford 延伸線通車，帶來阿得雷德第一批電聯車，2022 年起，往北的 Gawler 線也改用電車行駛。
intro.en: Adelaide got its railway in 1856, when the line to Port Adelaide opened. By 1958 every city tram route had closed except one, the line to the seaside at Glenelg that had opened in 1929, and it later became the starting point for a new network. From 2007 the trams were extended into the city center, and in 2018 a branch opened toward the Botanic Garden. On the rail side, the Seaford extension opened in February 2014 with Adelaide's first electric trains, and electric service began on the Gawler Line to the north in 2022.

seoDescription.en: High-resolution, zoomable Hamburg metro map for 2026 by Metliner, covering the Hamburg U-Bahn & S-Bahn network. Explore every line and station across Hamburg in one clean, unified design.
seoDescription.zh: Metliner 繪製的漢堡地鐵路線圖 2026：高解析、可縮放，涵蓋漢堡完整軌道路網，一張圖看懂所有路線與轉乘站。

intro.zh: 1912 年，漢堡地鐵從 Rathaus 到 Barmbek 的第一段通車，這是今天 U3 環狀線的起點，漢堡從此有了第一條地鐵；在此之前，電氣化的郊區鐵路在 1907 年就已開始行駛。雖然名字裡的「U」代表地下，漢堡的地鐵其實有不少路段在地面上，U3 線還有一段沿著港口行駛的高架路段。一百多年來，路網持續擴展：2008 年 S-Bahn 通到漢堡機場；2012 年通車的 U4 線開進新開發的 HafenCity，2018 年再延伸到 Elbbrücken 站。
intro.en: Hamburg got its first U-Bahn line in 1912, when the section from Rathaus to Barmbek opened as the start of today's U3 ring, though electric suburban trains had been running since 1907. Despite the U for underground, much of the network runs above ground, and the U3 includes an elevated stretch along the harbor. In the century since, the network has kept growing. The S-Bahn reached Hamburg Airport in 2008, and the U4, opened in 2012, runs into the new HafenCity district and was extended to Elbbrucken in 2018.

intro.zh: 2004 年 12 月，Tren Urbano 通車，聖胡安從此有了第一條城市軌道；2005 年 6 月，列車開始收費，正式全面營運。這條線從西南方的 Bayamón 出發，經過 Guaynabo、Río Piedras 與 Milla de Oro 金融區，通到 Santurce 的 Sagrado Corazón，全長約 17 公里、設 16 站，二十年來一直沒有延伸。2026 年 7 月，波多黎各取得約 1,100 萬美元，研究把路線延伸到舊聖胡安與機場。
intro.en: San Juan got its first urban rail line in December 2004, when Tren Urbano opened, and full fare service began in June 2005. The line starts in Bayamón to the southwest and runs through Guaynabo, Río Piedras, and the Milla de Oro financial district to Sagrado Corazón in Santurce, about 10.7 miles with 16 stations, and it has not been extended in the twenty years since. In July 2026 Puerto Rico secured about $11 million to study extending the line to Old San Juan and the airport.

seoDescription.en: High-resolution, zoomable Dublin metro map for 2026 by Metliner, covering the Dublin Luas & DART network. Explore every line and station across Dublin in one clean, unified design.
seoDescription.zh: Metliner 繪製的都柏林地鐵路線圖 2026：高解析、可縮放，涵蓋都柏林完整軌道路網，一張圖看懂所有路線與轉乘站。

intro.zh: 1984 年，沿著海岸行駛的 DART 電氣化通勤鐵路從 Howth 通到 Bray，都柏林從此有了第一條城市快速軌道。都柏林至今沒有地鐵，2004 年通車的 Luas 路面電車綠線與紅線，成了市區軌道的另一個骨幹：兩條線起初互不相連，乘客得在市中心步行約一公里換車；2017 年 Luas Cross City 通車，把綠線往北延伸穿過市中心並與紅線接通。規劃中的地鐵 MetroLink 已在 2025 年取得建設許可。
intro.en: Dublin got its first rapid urban rail line in 1984, when the electrified DART began running along the coast from Howth to Bray. The city still has no metro, and the Luas tram, whose Green and Red lines opened in 2004, became the other backbone of rail in the city. At first the two lines did not connect, and riders had to walk about a kilometer through the center to change between them. Luas Cross City, opened in 2017, carried the Green Line north through the center and linked it with the Red Line, and the planned MetroLink received approval to be built in 2025.
